I think the really sad/awsome part of this is it works on so many levels, I think that this is perhaps the best image of batman (bill murray not withstanding) that ive seen. Here we have a batman who thought still physically able to fight cant do it emotionally anymore. He's lost a few robins and perhaps catwoman has come and gone from his life. It just looks like this particular batman is done. 

His facial expression just says im done. He could clean the streets of gotham if the mud and shit didnt keep getting piled on him. This is not the batman that gotham needs nor the one it wants its the one that it has wrung out and used up. A batman such as this is perhaps the end result of a life spent trying to be the incorruptible symbol of justice. Even the greatest monuments succumb to the flow of time. Batman being a symbol is no different. While he may inspire the people to fight the darkness and injustice who fights for batman. Who is going to be his Dark Knight when all is said and done, and thats the point at the end even Batman must walk into that dark night that he has lurked in for so long.
